HelloWorld Java example
Compile:
```bash javac -d out src/HelloWorld.java ```
Run:
```bash java -cp out HelloWorld ```
Notes: - The `-d out` option places compiled classes into the `out` directory. - Run the commands from the `examples/HelloWorld` directory.
